task.title: Provider-first helper claim when preferred lane is busy
task.note_on_this_commit: The commit adding this manifest cannot name its own sha. It adds only files under this evidence directory; the code diff is entirely in db21b1a75 above.

history.why_superseded: The former PR head was a merge of a task branch stale since 2026-07-29. Measured two-dot against dev it deleted 134 supervisor.py defs (539 -> 405) and 139 test methods (611 -> 472), i.e. it would have reverted large parts of dev. It was reopened, never approved, so no review-proof tag was orphaned. The branch was rebuilt from dev tip and force-pushed.

scope.owned_layer: Supervisor helper-claim candidate selection only: plan_helper_claim_assignment, task_preferred_lane_blocks_helper_claim, task_next_preferred_helper_lane.
scope.not_changing: l12_provider_first_candidates itself, the reassignment call sites that already use it, helper-claim capacity and priority gating, bounded_fallback_candidates ordering, provider_permissions.py, and every config file. No config edits.
scope.composes_with: PR #4599 (OPS-DEV-BRANCH-CONTENT-RESTORE-20260806), which restores the symbols PR #4590's stale-base squash deleted; PR #4362 (SUP-PROVIDER-FIRST-HELPER-GUARD-20260729), which proposes a parallel guard on a far older base.

gap.reported: Claude2 was busy finalizing L12-OBS work, so the helper-claim path treated the SUP-L12 task as claimable and handed it to idle Codex2 purely because Codex2 sat in owner_fallbacks. Being busy or paused is not a reason to leave the provider-first family.
gap.root_cause: Three helper-claim entry points built their candidate list from raw owner_fallbacks / preferred_lane_order and never passed it through l12_provider_first_candidates, the provider-first filter that dev already applies on the automatic-reassignment path.

supervisor_py: plan_helper_claim_assignment: filter the assembled fallbacks through l12_provider_first_candidates(task, fallbacks) before the emptiness check, so an L12/SUP-L12 task returns no plan for a Codex-family idle agent.
task_preferred_lane_blocks_helper_claim: keep the declared lane order for the 'is any lane declared at all' test, then filter it provider-first before deciding whether the idle agent is in it.
task_next_preferred_helper_lane: filter task_preferred_lane_order(config, task) provider-first, so the paused-owner wait slot advances past a Codex lane to the next family lane instead of stalling.
test_supervisor_py: 7 new tests in ProcessQueueDispatchGuardTests: busy-owner claim to Codex is refused; busy-owner claim to Antigravity still succeeds; a non-L12 task still allows the Codex fallback; paused-owner declared Codex lane is refused; paused-owner slot hands to the family lane; task_next_preferred_helper_lane returns Antigravity for L12 and Codex2 for non-L12; plan_helper_claim_assignment returns None for Codex2 and a plan for Antigravity.
changes.scope_guard: l12_provider_first_candidates returns its input unchanged when task_is_l12_recovery_work(task) is false, so no non-L12 dispatch behaviour moves.

validation.environment_note: dev tip ab5caf7d4 cannot import supervisor at all: PR #4590's stale-base squash 23ae23c21 deleted provider_permissions.provider_auth_probe_due while supervisor.py:88 still imports it, and left 4 calls to rewrite_provider_health.classify_probe_failure_kind with no definition anywhere on dev. Exact error on dev tip: ImportError: cannot import name 'provider_auth_probe_due' from 'provider_permissions'. Repairing that is PR #4599's lane, not this one, so every run below uses PR #4599's head eb04f84873e2b33d92b9c7f0a6b047d6994aa98a as the base and applies this task's two-file diff on top. Reproduce with: git worktree add --detach <dir> eb04f8487 && git -C <dir> apply --3way <(git diff origin/dev..task/SUP-L12-HELPER-CLAIM-BUSY-PREFERRED-LANE-20260729 -- .orchestrator/supervisor.py .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py)

acceptance.criterion: reproduce busy Claude2 helper claim to Codex2
acceptance.evidence: test_dispatcher_does_not_helper_claim_busy_l12_lane_to_codex_family models a running Claude2 worker on L12-OBS-001 plus an idle Codex2, and fails on the unfixed base by claiming the task.

acceptance.criterion: defer or choose provider-first fallback before Codex-family
acceptance.evidence: test_dispatcher_helper_claims_busy_l12_lane_to_provider_first_fallback and test_dispatcher_helper_claim_hands_paused_owner_slot_to_provider_first_lane both assert the claim goes to Antigravity.

acceptance.criterion: prove Codex2 cannot claim merely due to busy preferred lane
acceptance.evidence: The two refusal tests assert persist_task_reassignment and queue_delivery_event are never called; test_dispatcher_helper_claim_keeps_codex_fallback_for_non_l12_task pins that this is scoped to L12 work only.
git diff --numstat origin/dev..HEAD lists only .orchestrator/supervisor.py and .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py plus this evidence directory.

613 passed / 162 subtests on eb04f8487 + this diff. It cannot be demonstrated on dev tip alone because dev tip cannot import supervisor at all (see validation.environment_note). This task neither caused nor repairs that; PR #4599 does.

please_check: That filtering the declared preferred_lane_order provider-first is the wanted policy, rather than stalling the task when the only remaining declared lane is Codex-family.

That keeping the unfiltered declared_lanes for the 'no lanes declared' early return in task_preferred_lane_blocks_helper_claim is correct: filtering first would turn an all-Codex declared order into 'no preference' and re-open the Codex path.
That deferring the provider_permissions.py / rewrite.provider_health repair to PR #4599 is the right split.
